description: Frontier of the g1 coverage checker after the round-4 pair rules (cover2.py rules '245pqr', pure DFS): systems that are NOT covered, are not small3, have no R0 point, and all of whose point deletions ARE covered. A SAT proof of s >= base (one NOT) for such a system makes it covered. Sorted by base, then n, then #pairs. n=8 entries are COMPLETE (all 8-point cores with any pair-sets; no cores on <= 7 points); n>=9 entries come only from the data sets explored (skeleton cores n=9,10 and their deletions; n=9 pair-core random sample of paircores.py).
